Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, struct, os, itertools
# brute small variations of IVF header fields and payload sizes, looking for crash/nonzero
for w,h,frames in [(64,64,1),(128,128,1),(64,64,2),(1920,1080,1)]:
  hdr = b'DKIF' + struct.pack('<HHIIII', 0, 32, w, h, 30, 1) + struct.pack('<I', frames)
  payload = b'\x00'*100
  path='/tmp/t.ivf'
  open(path,'wb').write(hdr + struct.pack('<IQ', len(payload), 0) + payload)
  r=subprocess.run(['./dump_obu',path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  print((w,h,frames), r.returncode, r.stderr.decode('latin1').splitlines()[:2])
PY
